title: The Man-Eaters of Tsavo, and Other East African Adventures
summary: "The Man-Eaters of Tsavo, and Other East African Adventures" by J. H. Patterson is a semi-autobiographical book published in 1907. Patterson eventually hunted down both man-eaters, earning international fame.
